# ScriptServerBlockEntity

*Server* · extends [`ScriptBlockEntity`](/scripting/common/block/ScriptBlockEntity)

Base for live server-side Scram block handles. Use these handles only on the server game thread. Mutations validate a detached candidate before applying it, then save and synchronize the loaded block. Handles expire when the chunk unloads or the original block entity is removed/replaced.

## Methods

### isValid {#isvalid}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the original block is still loaded in its server world; false for detached/client blocks

:::

### getNbtCompound {#getnbtcompound}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptNbtCompound`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtCompound) — a detached snapshot; changing it has no effect until [`setNbtCompound(ScriptNbtCompound)`](#setnbtcompound)

:::

### setNbtCompound {#setnbtcompound}

::: member

Replaces settings atomically, validates their synchronization limit and immediately saves/synchronizes them.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | [`ScriptNbtCompound`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtCompound) | complete block settings, not null; copied before decoding |

:::

### markDirty {#markdirty}

::: member

Saves and synchronizes this loaded block. API setters already do this automatically.

:::
